concept.title: DITA maps and their usage
concept.shortdesc: DITA maps serve a variety of roles, both setting up navigation hierarchies and creating relationships between topics and resoruces. These relationships can be both explicit based on relationship tables and attributes within the map, and implicit based on how topic references are nested within the map.
